prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1459; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the facts, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Conroe, Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving my sedan in the right lane on the access road.
Q: Tell me what you were doing right before the impact.
A: I was moving over to the left lane to get around a slow truck ahead of me. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to merge.
Q: Did you signal before changing lanes?
A: I believe I did. I had the turn signal on for a few seconds before I started moving.
Q: What happened next?
A: Another vehicle came up alongside me in the lane I was entering and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt the car jolt to the right.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not until it was right beside me. It seemed to come out of my blind spot quickly.
Q: Did you stop after the collision?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and turned on my hazard lights. The other driver got out and we exchanged information.
Q: Were you injured?
A: I felt sore right away. My neck feels stiff and there's a dull ache when I turn my head to the side. I also have some tightness across my shoulders.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I was evaluated at an urgent care clinic the same day and I've been seeing my family doctor since then for physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I'm hoping to recover fully soon.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
